items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: Charlie Creff was friendly with the banjoists that I replaced, Red Brown. I replaced Red Brown.

ctx.x: And he made some records with Charlie Creff I believe.

Well, Charlie Creff joined the band later. He was in the band. The same band. The same band. Because Dewey Jackson didn't come down with the, he came down for a while but he left to go back to St. Louis. And Charlie Creff came down. And, um, Charlie Creff was friendly with the banjoists that I replaced, Red Brown. I replaced Red Brown.
Was he from St. Louis? He was from that area.
